answer: Dock every identity at one wharf each epoch, where it must present a cipher sealed inside its own device's trusted enclave: a hardware attestation binding the epoch beacon to a unique device key that no software clone can forge. One machine can seal one cipher per epoch, so a farm of a thousand clones needs a thousand real enclaves, while one honest agent docks for free. Only attested identities may graze in the shared meadow of rewards, and a forged cipher burns the identity's standing forever.
